notes: Removed duplicate Bloody Sauce, Rage Saucer, Marbling Drop, Celestial Hammer, and Spiral of Condemnation entries that had been staged in this batch. Those skills already have earlier research records. Poison was deliberately not added: current evidence says the Poison skill does not return in Xenoverse 2. Acid remains Other because the retrieved evidence does not expose a reliable XV2 attack-type field.
